20234.long_desc:
A professional 20.1 inch LED Backlight Monitor designed for all arcade machines and retro game enthusiasts. This monitor offers a 4:3 viewing ratio with VGA and HDMI inputs and supports 15khz/24khz/31khz, and high definition up to 1600 x 1200 UXGA resolution. 1.9ms low response time, great colour depth the monitor has VESA mount(8 x M4*12) together with mounting frame. Now with audio out support. This is the LED backlight version LCD monitor. Get arcade ready with the 20.1 Inch LED Backlight Arcade Monitor which features a premium LG A grade panel with 4:3 resolution, making it perfect for your old-school 15khz/31khz Arcade games as well as offering the ability to run the latest arcade games in high definition. Highly suitable for Lowboy machines, cocktail tables and other arcade products. This monitor is the updated Arcooda 20inch model (our old model #17750 V18 firmware), where we have introduced new features, added extra harness and updated the firmware which is now version 30. The features of the new monitor are; - VGA & HDMI input, for RGB input, please use the Arcooda RGB board - video input support: 15khz, 24khz, 31khz, and up to 1600 x 1200 UXGA resolution at low monitor lag - extendable monitor adjustment board. Mount inside the monitor frame, or, use the extension to mount at the front of your arcade machine. - Audio output support: connect your HDMI input into the Arcooda 20.1 inch arcade LED Backlight monitor, then connect your 3.5mm audio jack out of the monitor into your audio system. - many monitor firmware adjustments have been made including fine tuning options and supporting EGA games such as Sega Model 2/3 game series. - mounting frame now supports VESA (8 x M4*12) or use the included mounting brackets to add into your arcade machine. The Arcooda 20.1 inch arcade LED Backlight monitor can be used for a wide range of applications, from home user, to arcade machine and industrial machinery and equipment; ARCADE USE: use the side metal mounting frame to embed the monitor into your arcade cabinet. Then, use the extension cable to run the monitor adjustment board to be at the front of your arcade machine for easy adjustment. INDUSTRIAL USE USE: if retrofitting into existing equipment, for easy use, please consider the Arcooda RGB board for plug and play options. This will allow you to plug in your 10pin harness and have quick colour intensity adjustment options. HOME USE: through the VESA mount(8 x M4*12), add your own desktop stand or VESA arm to the monitor, mount the monitor control board inside the metal frame and easily install your gaming equipment.

Please Note: Desktop monitor stands are not included. Please review below monitor stand options; #20138 Standard Desktop Stand #20137 Rotating Desktop Stand with vertical lift function * Monitors are being manufactured on pre-paid basis, and shipping is on first come/paid, first served basis. We currently have many backorders which need to be shipped first, then your order will go into the build table. Thank you everyone for your patience.
